product_overview: CodeType is a developer-focused typing mastery platform for practicing real code syntax, tracking typing telemetry, and improving speed and accuracy across multiple programming languages. It also adds AI-generated drills, analytics, competitive multiplayer, achievements, and profile-based progression.
core_goals: Practice typing real programming code snippets with syntax-aware feedback
Browse, filter, and launch curated or custom coding templates
Generate tailored practice snippets using AI-based prompts and settings
Review typing performance trends and error diagnostics over time
Compete in multiplayer typing races and compare results on leaderboards
Track progression through achievements, XP, levels, and profile stats
Customize typing preferences, audio, caret, theme, and account-related settings

features.name: Code Typing Practice Workspace
features.description: A syntax-aware typing drill workspace where users practice copying code snippets with live speed, accuracy, and error feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /practice -> Read the displayed code snippet -> Type the snippet in sequence -> Watch live WPM, accuracy, and error counters update -> Complete the snippet -> Review the results summary modal

Navigate to /practice -> Start typing a snippet -> Make typing mistakes -> Observe the error highlighting and diagnostic counts -> Correct the mistakes while continuing the drill in strict mode -> Finish the session and review performance
Navigate to /practice -> Start a drill -> Press Escape to pause the session -> Resume the drill -> Continue typing until completion

Navigate to /practice -> Start a drill -> Listen to mechanical keystroke feedback while typing -> Observe the virtual keyboard highlight the next target key and finger zone guidance -> Finish the drill and see completion confetti

features.name: Code Templates Catalog & Custom Template Creator
features.description: A browsable catalog of programming templates with filters, detail views, and the ability to save custom templates for future practice.
user_flows: Navigate to /templates -> Filter templates by language, category, or difficulty -> Search for a specific snippet by title or tag -> Open a template detail view -> Launch practice from the selected template
Navigate to /templates -> Browse the catalog -> Open a template detail view -> Review the code structure and metadata -> Start practicing that template

Navigate to /templates -> Open the create template flow -> Enter a title, language, difficulty, category, tags, and code body -> Save the template to the library -> Open the saved template later and start practice

features.name: AI Practice Generator Studio
features.description: An AI-assisted snippet generator that creates code practice material based on language, difficulty, length, and custom instructions.
user_flows: Navigate to /ai-generator -> Select a programming language -> Choose a difficulty level and length mode -> Enter custom prompt instructions -> Generate a snippet -> Preview the generated code -> Start practice with the generated snippet
Navigate to /ai-generator -> Pick a preset prompt or write a custom one -> Generate alternative code -> Review the new result -> Save the snippet to the template library
Navigate to /ai-generator -> Generate a snippet -> Copy the code for reuse -> Reload a previous generation from history -> Use it for practice

features.name: Diagnostic Reports & Telemetry Analytics
features.description: An analytics page for reviewing typing progress, speed trends, accuracy trends, error categories, and session history.
user_flows: Navigate to /reports -> Review speed and accuracy charts -> Inspect session history entries -> Compare language performance and progression trends -> Use the insights to identify improvement areas
Navigate to /reports -> Switch the timeframe filter -> Observe the charts and summary metrics update -> Inspect the drill history table -> Re-practice a past session
Navigate to /reports -> Review syntax error categorization breakdown -> Compare brackets, punctuation, identifiers, and whitespace errors -> Export session data as a file
Navigate to /reports -> Open the empty analytics state -> Load demo data -> Review populated charts and history records

features.name: Multiplayer Arena
features.description: A competitive typing arena where users choose game modes, join or create matches, race against simulated opponents, and review match outcomes.
user_flows: Navigate to /multiplayer -> Select a game mode -> Enter quick match or matchmaking -> Join a race lobby -> Type the snippet during the race -> Review final standings and rating results
Navigate to /multiplayer -> Select a custom room mode -> Create a room with desired settings -> Wait for opponents or bots to join -> Ready up -> Begin the race -> View the match summary and podium

Navigate to /multiplayer -> Browse available lobbies -> Search for a match that fits the desired language or mode -> Join the lobby -> Race against the current participants -> See WPM ranking at the end

features.name: Global Leaderboard
features.description: A rankings page for comparing typing performance across timeframes, languages, and users.
user_flows: Navigate to /leaderboard -> Switch between daily, weekly, and all-time views -> Filter by programming language -> Search for a username -> Review the podium and ranking table
Navigate to /leaderboard -> Inspect the top-three podium cards -> Scroll the leaderboard table -> Compare accuracy, tests completed, and WPM across users
Navigate to /leaderboard -> Change the metric view between speed and XP -> Observe the standings recalculate -> Check the current user's standing relative to others

features.name: Gamified Achievements
features.description: A badge and progress system that rewards speed, accuracy, consistency, language breadth, and competitive performance.
user_flows: Navigate to /achievements -> Filter badges by category -> Switch between unlocked and locked views -> Review progress bars for tiered achievements -> Inspect reward details for a badge
Navigate to /achievements -> Open an achievement detail view -> Read the badge requirement and reward information -> Check whether it is unlocked or still in progress

features.name: Developer Profile & Friends Network
features.description: A personal profile area for viewing performance stats, editing identity details, and managing friends.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Review level, XP, best speed, accuracy, and total sessions -> Inspect skill breakdown and activity heatmap -> View social and career progress
Navigate to /profile -> Open the profile edit flow -> Change display name, handle, bio, or avatar styling -> Save the updates -> Return to the profile with the new identity details
Navigate to /profile -> View the friends list -> Add a friend by handle -> Review the updated network list -> Remove a friend if needed

features.name: User Settings & Typing Preferences
features.description: A settings area for customizing typing behavior, visual style, audio feedback, and account data preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Toggle key click sound effects -> Choose a switch sound theme -> Adjust caret style, font size, and theme preferences -> Save the updated typing setup
Navigate to /settings -> Enable or disable the instant restart shortcut -> Return to practice with the updated control preference
Navigate to /settings -> Open account data controls -> Update identity or email information -> Confirm the changes -> Review the new saved settings
Navigate to /settings -> Choose to reset preferences -> Confirm the reset -> Return to the default typing configuration

routes.description: Executive typing performance overview, quick stats, velocity telemetry, recent activity heatmap, and quick start practice
Core code typing drill workspace with PrismJS tokenization, real-time WPM, accuracy, errors, virtual keyboard, and completion modal
Code template catalog with language, category, and difficulty filtering, template details modal, and custom template creation
AI code snippet generator studio supporting customized language, difficulty, length, prompt instructions, and instant practice
Detailed telemetry analytics, Recharts progression curves, syntax error categorization diagnostics, and session history
7-mode developer esports arena featuring real-time racing simulation, custom rooms, live progress bars, and match summaries
Global competitive rankings, podium for top 3 typists, timeframe filtering (Daily/Weekly/All-time), language filtering, and search
46 gamified achievements across Velocity, Precision, Polyglot, and Endurance categories with unlock progress tracking
Developer profile footprint, XP progression, level milestones, friends network, and language radar analytics
Typing preferences, mechanical switch audio sound themes, caret customization, theme settings, and account data controls

features.name: Code Typing Practice Workspace
features.description: Real-time code syntax typing drill engine with character-by-character tokenization, error tracking, virtual keyboard, and mechanical audio clicks
user_interactions: Type code in the interactive editor matching the highlighted snippet
View real-time WPM, accuracy percentage, time elapsed, and error counts
Observe highlighted virtual keyboard keys showing finger placement zones
Hear mechanical click audio feedback on keystroke
Reset drill or switch snippets via header controls
View completed drill summary modal with velocity charts and confetti
Save results to local storage session history

features.name: Code Templates Catalog & Custom Template Creator

user_interactions: Filter templates by programming language (Python, C++, JS, TS, Go, Rust, Java, SQL)
Filter templates by category (Algorithms, Data Structures, Web, Concurrency)
Search templates by title or tag keywords
Open template detail modal to inspect code structure
Launch practice session directly from template
Click Create Template to open modal, input code, language, title, and save to library

features.name: AI Practice Generator Studio
features.description: Synthesize tailor-made coding snippets based on language, difficulty level, length mode, and custom prompts
user_interactions: Select target programming language
Choose difficulty tier (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced)
Choose length mode (Short, Medium, Long)
Type custom prompt instructions (e.g., async await handlers, binary search tree)
Click Generate Snippet to synthesize code
Preview generated code with syntax highlighting
Click Practice Now to jump into interactive drill with generated snippet
Click Save Template to save snippet to local templates collection

features.name: Diagnostic Reports & Telemetry Analytics
features.description: Interactive Recharts visualizations of typing velocity, accuracy trends, and syntax error categorization
user_interactions: Inspect WPM progression timeline and session history
Analyze syntax error breakdown across Brackets, Punctuation, Identifiers, and Whitespace
Review language performance radar and speed benchmarks
Filter analytics by timeframe (7 days, 30 days, all time)
Export telemetry session data as JSON file
Clear or reset historical session data

features.name: Multiplayer Arena
features.description: Competitive typing arena featuring 7 game modes, simulated rivals, real-time velocity progress bars, and match standings
user_interactions: Select game mode (1v1 Ranked, 4-Player Battle, 8-Player Royale, Time Attack, Syntax Sprint, Speed Rush, Custom Room)
Enter matchmaking queue or create custom match lobby
Race against bots and simulated competitors with live progress bars
Type code snippet under time or speed constraints
View final standings, WPM leaderboard, and rating changes

user_interactions: Switch timeframes between Daily, Weekly, and All-Time
Filter rankings by specific programming language
Search users by username
View top 3 podium cards with avatar, rank badge, and WPM
Inspect full leaderboard table with rank, user, accuracy, tests completed, and WPM

features.description: 46 unlockable developer achievements with category filters and progress trackers
user_interactions: Filter achievements by category (All, Velocity, Precision, Polyglot, Endurance, Special)
Toggle filter to view Unlocked vs Locked achievements
Check completion progress bars for tiered achievements
View reward badges and unlocked timestamps

features.name: Developer Profile & Friends Network

user_interactions: View level badge, current XP, and progress towards next level
View personal best WPM, accuracy, and total tests count
Edit user profile name, handle, and bio
View friend list with online statuses and WPM statistics
Add new friend by handle or remove friend

features.name: User Settings & Typing Preferences
features.description: Configurable sound switches, audio themes, visual caret styles, font sizing, and local data management
user_interactions: Toggle mechanical keyboard click sound effects on or off
Select switch audio sound theme (Cherry MX Blue, Brown, Red)
Choose caret cursor style (Line, Block, Underline)
Adjust editor font size and theme preferences
Toggle instant restart shortcut key
Reset preferences to defaults

known_limitations.issue: Backend API is not present, all data is managed via client-side LocalStorage and in-memory mock stores
known_limitations.impact: Multiplayer competitors and match matchmaking are simulated client-side rather than connecting to live external WebSocket servers
